signal: Nextech launched Cora Scribe, its first AI assistant capability, in January 2026 and expanded Nextech Payments with Stripe and Affirm in April.

email.body1:
Connie, saw Nextech launched Cora Scribe and expanded the Payments platform with Stripe and Affirm this year.

A bigger product footprint usually means more dermatology, ophthalmology, and plastics practices in play than your team can work before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Connie, quick follow-up for Nextech.

As Cora and Payments open new conversations, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the quarter, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nextech needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Connie, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other specialty health-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Connie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while the team beds in Cora and Payments, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a product push is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a specialty health-tech motion? I will tailor it to Nextech either way.
